data.title: Elvira
data.about:
Elvira is a luxury living retreat located inside Dubai Hills Estate, only a few minutes from Downtown Dubai, where you’ll find the city’s corporate, financial, and retail zones. The area, which is bordered by Al Khail Road and is conveniently located between Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina, provides easy access to the city’s most renowned attractions.

Choose from stunning one to three bedroom apartments that are comfortable, convenient, and connected. These structures are situated on Dubai Hills Park and within a few minutes’ walk from Dubai Hills Mall. Enjoy never-before-seen luxuries and live in a community with the greatest medical and educational resources. This luxurious neighborhood has it all, including huge green areas surrounded by trees.
